image.prompt: Image 1 is a photograph of a farmhouse yard at sunset: keep exactly everything in it - the camera position, the farmhouse on the left, the wooden yard gate in the middle of the back wall, the bare tree, the walls, the golden field, the round stone well at the front right, and the low golden sun at the upper right with long shadows toward the lower left. Put four people into this yard, each with a long shadow toward the lower left. At the front right beside the well stands the young woman from image 2, full figure, her face, hair and plain grey-white cotton dress exactly as in image 2, long sleeves to her wrists; her body turned toward the yard gate, her face in left profile, eyes on the gate, lips closed; one round wooden bucket of water with a rope handle held low in her right hand; a long strip of soft half-transparent pale grey gauze tied by a thin grey tie over her left ear only, its free end blown out past her left cheek and shoulder in the wind, her face bare. Small and far back, in the yard gate in the middle of the back wall, stands the man on the right of image 3, full figure, his face, topknot with its green jade ornament and sapphire-blue brocade robe exactly as in image 3, a folded fan held shut in his right hand, his body half turned toward the well, his eyes on the well. In the middle of the yard between the camera and the gate, two people the same size stand shoulder to shoulder with their backs to the camera, both facing the gate, full figures: on the left the man on the left of image 3, the back of his head and his topknot tied with a cloth band toward us, his faded blue-grey scholar's robe patched at one elbow; at his right shoulder, the same distance from the camera, the top of her buns at the height of his ear, a slender young woman seen only from behind: her black hair gathered up into just two round buns set high on her head, one on each side, one short pink silk ribbon wound tight round the base of each bun with its ends tucked in; every strand is up in the two buns, so the bare nape of her neck shows smooth and clear down to the pink inner collar; a light peach-pink silk jacket and a pleated peach-pink skirt; the back of her head faces straight away from the camera. Exactly four people, each one once. A photorealistic live-action film still of a Chinese historical costume drama, natural perspective, deep focus, real skin, hair, cloth and earth textures, warm golden evening light, filling the whole frame edge to edge.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action film footage of real actors in an ancient Chinese (Song-dynasty) period drama, shot on a cinema camera. The four people shown in <Picture 1> stay exactly where they stand in it from the first frame to the last: A-ling tall at the front right beside the round stone well, Wei Shaoqing small in the yard gate in the middle of the back wall, Xu Yan standing at the left of the yard before the house wall facing the gate, and the young woman with the two high round buns in the middle foreground with her back to us, a flat wooden box held against her chest; the first frame fixes their faces, hair and costumes, the yard and the low golden evening light, never the mood. A-ling stands still, her face in left profile, her eyes on the young woman, her lips closed, her hand on the well windlass; she draws one slow breath, her shoulders rising a little and settling. Wei Shaoqing stands frozen in the gate, his eyes on Xu Yan; once his head turns a little toward the well and slowly back. Xu Yan's head turns a little toward the young woman and settles back toward the gate. The young woman keeps her head still, the back of her head toward us the whole shot, the bare nape of her neck clear above the pink inner collar, her two buns and their tight pink ribbons unchanged. Only the loose strip of pale grey gauze, a few strands of A-ling's hair and the hems of their clothes stir in the evening breeze. Only these four people are in the frame the whole shot, each one once; nobody walks into or out of the frame; no second copy of anyone appears. A-ling, Wei Shaoqing and Xu Yan say nothing in this shot: their lips stay pressed together from the first frame to the last, no talking, no mouthing words. The low golden evening sunlight and the long shadows stay unchanged. Every person in the frame wears dark cloth shoes on both feet. The camera holds a static shot. One continuous shot. The picture is clean, with no subtitles, captions or text anywhere on screen. Natural, realistic human motion of real actors; faces, hair and costumes stay as in the first frame.
